note: Registered the server in .mcp.json, but a brand-new MCP server entry is only picked up by Claude Code on session start/reconnect, not mid-session. To actually exercise the tools now, we ran a real FastMCP stdio client against mcp_server/server.py — the same connection mechanism Claude Code uses — and called list_tools()/call_tool() exactly as the vibe coder would. This session should reconnect to campus-customs on next restart so the tools show up natively.
